# exo_mailbox_regional_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing MailboxRegionalConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `archive` (Boolean) Maps to the -Archive parameter.
- `date_format` (String) Maps to the -DateFormat parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `language` (String) Maps to the -Language parameter.
- `localize_default_folder_name` (Boolean) Maps to the -LocalizeDefaultFolderName parameter.
- `mailbox_location` (String) Maps to the -MailboxLocation parameter.
- `time_format` (String) Maps to the -TimeFormat parameter.
- `time_zone` (String) Maps to the -TimeZone parameter.
- `use_custom_routing` (Boolean) Maps to the -UseCustomRouting parameter.
